title: Goa approves AI Policy 2026, with most of the money for skills
summary: Goa's three-year AI policy puts 60% of its outlay into skilling and targets 50,000 AI-trained graduates by 2030.
body: On 20 November 2026 the Goa Cabinet approved the Goa AI Policy 2026 along with five flagship schemes. It is a three-year roadmap for using AI in education, industry, startups and governance.

- 60% of the outlay goes to AI skilling and capacity building, 20% to startups and 20% to infrastructure.
- Target: train and certify 50,000 graduates in AI skills by 2030.
- Access to AI computing, about 100 GPUs or equivalent, through partners such as C-DAC and IndiaAI.
- A Konkani large language model, with speech and translation tools through BHASHINI.
The IndiaAI Mission, approved in 2024, funds shared computing, Indian datasets and foundation models. Several states, including Rajasthan, have announced their own AI policies in 2026.
